TC-23/S19.title: Real voice on iPhone and Android, on Wi-Fi and then on cellular, both modes, engine recorded
TC-23/S19.detail: Not run. It scores real speech-to-text (numbers in ten dictated sentences, per network, per platform, engine per take): the emulator has no microphone input or cellular network, and a take would have to open the live gpt-live session (prepareSession -> OpenAI), which the local stack must not do. With the test accounts' on-device marker the app uses Android's on-device recogniser instead, which is not the physicians' engine.
